introduction: A Dream to Build a Better Way of Living
A Complete, Green and Sustainable Township for Generations
More Than a Township. A Vision for a Better Tomorrow.

sections.title: The Dream Behind Anondo Bhubon
paragraphs: Every meaningful development begins with a dream. Some dreams are inspired by personal ambition, while others emerge from a desire to create something meaningful for society.
Anondo Bhubon was born from my dream to create a better way of living for the people of Bangladesh.

Throughout my professional and business life, I have had opportunities to visit many countries, including the United States, Japan, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia and the United Arab Emirates. These experiences helped me understand how thoughtful urban planning can transform people's lives.

My stay in Singapore in 2015 was particularly inspiring. I observed how modern residential communities, commercial centres, workplaces, educational institutions, transportation and extensive greenery could coexist within a carefully planned urban environment.
It strengthened my belief that the people of Bangladesh deserve the same opportunity to enjoy a modern, healthy and environmentally sustainable lifestyle.

Bangladesh is progressing rapidly, but unplanned urbanization continues to create challenges—traffic congestion, environmental pollution, disappearing green spaces and inadequate community facilities.
I realized that constructing more houses alone would not solve these problems.
We needed to create complete communities, not merely residential developments.
From this conviction, the vision of Anondo Bhubon emerged.

sections.title: A Complete Township for Life and Enterprise
paragraphs: Envisioned across more than 4,000 bighas of land near Purbachal, Anondo Bhubon is being planned as a comprehensive, green, sustainable and economically vibrant integrated township.
It is not simply a housing project.
It is a place where people will live, work, establish businesses, create employment, pursue education, enjoy recreation and build their futures within one connected community.
Our residential master plan incorporates five distinct sectors—Premium Plus, Premium, Executive, General and Economy—to accommodate families with different aspirations and economic circumstances.

A dedicated Luxury Villa District and a 295-bigha Condominium District will further enrich the residential environment with exclusive villas, modern high-rise residences and integrated community amenities.

Schools, playgrounds, parks and gathering spaces are planned throughout the residential sectors, while major roads, including proposed 120-foot, 80-foot and 60-foot corridors, will connect the township's neighbourhoods and activity centres.
Our objective is to ensure that every community benefits from thoughtful planning, accessible facilities and a healthy living environment.

sections.title: Nature Is Our First Priority
paragraphs: At Anondo Bhubon, environmental sustainability is not an additional feature. It is the foundation of our development philosophy.

One of our most meaningful ambitions is the planned revival of the Old Brahmaputra River, reconnecting its historic watercourse with the Shitalakshya River, subject to environmental and hydrological feasibility.
Alongside the river, a network of canals, lakes, water bodies, parks and landscaped green corridors will help shape the township's natural character.
Our proposed Forest Walkways will extend across different parts of Anondo Bhubon, connecting communities with greenery, shaded pedestrian routes and open spaces.
These green networks are intended to support biodiversity, improve the local environment and encourage healthier everyday living.
We believe modern development should not replace nature. It should protect, restore and coexist with it.

sections.title: Creating Opportunities, Not Just Properties
paragraphs: A truly sustainable township must also provide economic opportunities.
Within our proposed 918-bigha commercial and technology zone, we envision modern business centres, trading facilities, technology enterprises and environmentally compatible industries.

A major component will be Anondo Digital Valley, initially allocated approximately 226.80 bighas, where freelancers, startups, software developers and technology entrepreneurs can access modern offices, reliable digital infrastructure and professional support.
A proposed AI and Digital Technology Institute will contribute to developing skilled manpower and supporting the next generation of entrepreneurs.

Our vision also includes a landmark commercial destination on at least 30 bighas of land, integrating shopping, business, landscaped parks, pedestrian walkways and water features. We aspire to make it an attractive destination for residents and visitors alike.

Sports and recreation will be another defining feature, with playgrounds across residential neighbourhoods and plans for an international-standard cricket stadium, football stadium and comprehensive sports complex.
Together with education, healthcare, civic services and recreational facilities, these developments are intended to create a complete environment for modern life.

sections.title: Building with Trust and Responsibility
paragraphs: I believe that a development of this magnitude must be guided by more than commercial ambition.
At Anondo Real Estate Group, trust, integrity, sincerity, dedication and accountability are our capital.
Every family choosing Anondo places its confidence in us. Every investment represents someone's expectations, savings and dreams.
Our responsibility is to honour that trust through transparent communication, responsible planning, quality development and long-term commitment.
We recognize that building a township of this scale requires time, substantial investment, careful planning and disciplined implementation.
Our success will not be measured only by plots sold or buildings constructed, but by the quality of life created, employment generated, environment preserved and confidence earned.

sections.title: A Legacy for Future Generations
paragraphs: The name Anondo means joy.
To me, it represents the deeper satisfaction that comes from doing something meaningful for people, society and our country.
It is the joy of seeing families establish their homes, children grow up in green surroundings, young professionals build successful careers and entrepreneurs create opportunities for others.
My aspiration is that Anondo Bhubon will become a model of responsible, integrated and environmentally sustainable township development in Bangladesh.
A place that future generations will inherit with pride, gratitude and a sense of responsibility.
Anondo Bhubon exists because it is my dream to build a green, sustainable lifestyle for our people.
We are not merely developing a township.
We are creating a legacy of green, sustainable living, economic opportunity and community well-being for generations to come.

closing: A Complete Township for Life, Enterprise and Future Generations
Where Nature, Opportunity and Modern Living Come Together.

Gazi Md. Mozammel Hoque
Founder & Chairman
Anondo Real Estate Group
